stem: Represent the ordered pairs (0, -1), (1, 1) and (2, 3) graphically in the coordinate plane. Tap each point.
solution: The x-axis is horizontal and the y-axis vertical, meeting at O.
Plot (0, -1): at 0 on the x-axis, then 1 unit down.
Each ordered pair is one and only one point.

hints.text: Each ordered pair in the list gives one point. Check that every pair has been plotted.
Only the pairs listed are plotted. Check each point against the pairs, moving along x first and then along y.
Check the direction for each move: right or left along x, then up or down along y, as the signs say.
